replacements.before: His elder half-brother Murong Han, who held the title general who establishes might, was a brilliant warrior whom Huang resented, while his full brothers Murong Ren and Murong Zhao, both favored by Hui, also stirred his jealousy.
replacements.after: Earlier, Huang's elder half-brother Murong Han, general who establishes might, was a brilliant warrior whom Huang had long resented, while his full brothers Murong Ren, general who subdues the caitiffs, and Murong Zhao, general of Guangwu, were both favored by Hui, which also stirred his jealousy.
replacements.reason: Chinese 初 (flashback marker) and the titles 征虜 (Ren) and 廣武 (Zhao) are omitted although Han's title 建威 is kept.

replacements.before: Huang dispatched his brother Murong You and Marshal Tong Shou against him.
replacements.after: Huang dispatched his brother Murong You, general who establishes martial power, and Marshal Tong Shou against him.
replacements.reason: Chinese 建武幼 includes You's title 建武 (將軍), omitted in English.
